If we wanted to add a UA-defined timeout here separate from the fetch timeout, then this would be where we add it. Something like:

> A Document is render-blocked if both of the following are true:
> 
> - document's render-blocking element set is non-empty, or document's awaiting parser-inserted body flag is true; and
> - The [relative high resolution time](https://w3c.github.io/hr-time/#dfn-relative-high-resolution-time) for document's [relevant global object] has not exceeded an [implementation-defined] timeout value.
